# Preetham Kyanam — Full Documentation

> The live site (https://preetham.org) renders entirely in lowercase as a stylistic
> choice. This file uses normal case for readability. Live GitHub figures on the
> Stats and Projects pages are auto-refreshed daily from the GitHub API and on every
> page load, so any numbers quoted here may lag the live site.

## Home

Preetham Kyanam — computer engineer, Virginia Tech '23, based in Ashburn, Virginia.

He builds at the intersection of embedded systems, emulation, and AI agents —
"bytes on the wire, transistors on the board, agents on top."

Currently:
- IT contractor at Harrington Process Solutions (HIPCO), working on internal
  applications and AI initiatives across a .NET, React, ColdFusion, and SQL stack,
  using AI tooling including Claude, Cursor, and Devin.
- Independent AI R&D under Belweave, his personal lab and the umbrella for projects
  like trifecta, brainbase, and graphbrain.

What he works on: AI agent infrastructure, embedded systems and emulation,
full-stack and native development, and open source (30+ public repositories).

## About

Software / computer engineer based in Ashburn, Virginia. Graduated from Virginia
Tech in May 2023 with a B.S. in Computer Engineering, concentrating in Controls,
Robotics and Autonomy.

Belweave is his independent AI R&D lab — not a registered company, but the umbrella
he puts his projects under. He learns by building: a Rust CLI, an Arduino library
that drives a Roomba, a GBA emulator written from the CPU up, an MCP server that
wakes a PS5.

Technical interests: AI agents, MCP, knowledge graphs, embedded systems, emulation,
ARM/ESP32, Rust, C/C++, TypeScript, Swift, Next.js, AWS.

A live view of GitHub activity. Numbers (public repos, total stars, followers, top
language) are recomputed daily from the GitHub API; embedded stat cards
(github-readme-stats) refresh on every page load.

## Work

IT Contractor — AI initiatives, Harrington Process Solutions (HIPCO), Ashburn, VA,
present. Builds and maintains internal applications (.NET, React/Vite/Next.js, Adobe
ColdFusion, SQL); works on AI initiatives; ships with Claude, Cursor, and Devin.

Founder — independent AI R&D, Belweave, self-directed. A personal AI R&D lab (not a
registered company). Builds trifecta (cross-platform coding agent platform),
brainbase + graphbrain (knowledge-graph API for agents with a Neo4j backend), and a
rotating set of experiments across agents, emulation, and embedded systems.

Full Stack Developer, System Soft Technologies, Ashburn, VA (hybrid),
September 2022 – March 2024. Developed and maintained web applications with Node.js
and React; supported backend API and database work; agile team.

Campus Leader, Apple, Blacksburg, VA, May 2018 – February 2019. Apple campus brand
ambassador at Virginia Tech; collaborated with Apple Education and Apple Music
marketing on campus activations.

Entrepreneurship — Founder, Kairobo Platforms LLC, Ashburn, VA,
May 2024 – October 2024. Startup developing low-cost autonomous ground vehicles
(AGVs) using consumer mobile devices (iPad Pro LiDAR, Neural Engine, cameras) as the
compute platform. Dissolved pre-product after validating the scope required
additional resources.

## Education

Virginia Tech — B.S. Computer Engineering, May 2023. Concentration: Controls,
Robotics and Autonomy (CRA). Coursework: data structures and algorithms, software
engineering, database systems, operating systems, embedded systems.

Certifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner; AWS Certified AI Practitioner; AWS
Machine Learning Engineer — Associate (in progress).

emulation.

## Projects

Built under Belweave, plus a live feed of latest GitHub activity (auto-refreshed
daily).

Flagships:

trifecta — Cross-platform coding agent platform. A desktop server that runs AI
coding agents, paired with native iOS and Android clients to chat with the agent,
review changes, and manage the workflow from anywhere. TypeScript. Public beta,
active development. Live: https://trifecta.belweave.com . Source:
https://github.com/pkyanam/trifecta

brainbase + graphbrain — A knowledge-graph API for AI agents (brainbase), backed by
graphbrain, a Neo4j-powered graph database with one-click provisioning. TypeScript.
Source: https://github.com/pkyanam/brainbase and https://github.com/pkyanam/graphbrain

ArduRoomba — Modular Arduino library that revives legacy iRobot Roombas with full
Open Interface support over WiFi and BLE, across Arduino Uno R4, ESP32, and ESP8266.
Published to the Arduino Library Manager and PlatformIO. Most-starred project;
covered by Hackster.io. C++. Source: https://github.com/pkyanam/ArduRoomba

More:

claude-ps5-mcp — MCP server that lets Claude Code discover, register, and wake PS5
consoles on the local network via PSN auth, UDP discovery, and Wake-on-LAN.
Published to npm. TypeScript. Source: https://github.com/pkyanam/claude-ps5-mcp

gba-next — Game Boy Advance emulator with ARM7TDMI CPU emulation, running entirely
in the browser on Next.js. Source: https://github.com/pkyanam/gba-next

codex-ios — Native iOS app for OpenAI Codex, plus a Swift SDK for the Codex API.
In active development. Swift. Source: https://github.com/pkyanam/codex-ios

OpenHome Abilities — Custom voice AI abilities for the OpenHome smart speaker
platform; selected for OpenHome's developer program with a hardware dev kit. Python.
Platform: https://openhome.ai

gh-contributions-menu-bar — Native macOS menu bar app showing the GitHub
contribution graph. Swift. Source:
https://github.com/pkyanam/gh-contributions-macos-menu-bar
